summary: Static code-review audit of pricing cascade. Found CRITICAL pricing-mismatch bugs on CityLandingPage (visible UI on all 13 city pages still shows OLD $650/$750/$1000 prices) and HomePage JSON-LD Offer schema (still emits OLD 650/750/900). Other pages (ServicesPage, ServiceAreasPage tier eyebrows, FAQPage, IntakePage, ClientIntakePage, HomePage Section 4/5 visible copy) are correctly updated to new locked 2026 figures.

ui_bugs.issue:
All 13 city pages render VISIBLE old prices in the hero Pricing block and the city-specific FAQ answer. Lines 130-131 set priceStart = data.priceStart || 650 and priceRangeTop = 1000/1200 (old values). Lines 336/339 render '

Starting at $650

' (or $750 for Asheboro/Salisbury) and '$650–$1000' range. The cityFaqs answer at line 136 also embeds the old $650/$750 values. Meta description (seoDesc) IS correct ($1,200/$1,200+travel) but the on-page rendered text is OLD. This is HIGH PRIORITY — every city landing page shows the wrong price to users.

Lines 111-113 still emit OLD prices in structured data: Safety Walkthrough price '650', Doc Review '750' (or '950' when flag=true; flag is false in env), Incident '900'. Should be 1200 / 1300 / 1500. This is the schema Google reads. Visible Section 4/5 copy is correct, only the JSON-LD is wrong.
Line 104 priceRange '$950–$12000' — low bound should arguably be $1,200 (Walkthrough min) since Quarterly $950 is a recurring rate, not a one-time engagement. Minor.

action_items: Fix /app/frontend/src/pages/CityLandingPage.js: change default priceStart fallback from 650 to 1200, update priceRangeTop logic, update city FAQ answer template, and update outer-tier (Asheboro/Salisbury) display to '$1,200 + travel fee'. All 13 city pages affected.

Fix /app/frontend/src/pages/HomePage.js JSON-LD hasOfferCatalog Offer prices (lines 111-113): 650→1200, 750/950→1300, 900→1500. Remove the GL_WEB_008 feature flag conditional since the cascade is now live.
Verify /app/frontend/public/llms.txt and /app/frontend/scripts/generate-seo-pages.js JSON-LD (not viewed due to token limits — main agent should diff against locked figures).
critical_code_review_comments: CityLandingPage stores seoDesc and visible-price logic in separate places — they are out of sync. Consolidate price source-of-truth.
HomePage gates JSON-LD prices behind REACT_APP_GL_WEB_008_ENABLED but visible copy is unconditional. Inconsistent — flag should be removed or both should be gated.
ServicesPage line 447 anchor 'Booked separately ... start at $2,500' — math is $1,200 + $1,300 = $2,500 so OK, but copy is brittle if either base price changes.
